experience.support: Select what interests you. The final proposal will be defined from your event.

contact.title: Almost there
contact.support: Check the details of your event and add your contact details.

location.label: Location
location.hint: City or locality, for example Lugano, Zurich, Geneva or Locarno. A full address is not needed. The examples are not a confirmed coverage area.

date.label: Date
date.hint: If the date is already decided, choose it. A past date is not accepted.
date.undecided: I have not decided the date yet

experiences.label: Experiences
experiences.hint: A selection of interest. It does not confirm that every service is available in every place, or a number of tables or staff.

notes.label: Would you like to tell us more?
notes.hint: Venue, times, atmosphere, particular needs or any useful information.

fields.phoneHint: A Swiss or international number. A Swiss prefix is not required.
fields.preference: How would you prefer to be contacted
fields.preferenceHint: A preference, not confirmation that the channel is already active.

corporate.title: Corporate event
corporate.body: A work meeting, a presentation or an evening with colleagues.

dinner.title: Corporate dinner
dinner.body: Entertainment for the evening. The menu is not part of the proposal.

wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.body: A moment of entertainment, not the organisation of the wedding.

private.title: Private celebration
private.body: A birthday, an anniversary or another celebration among guests.

gala.title: Convention or gala
gala.body: A formal evening, to be defined in the proposal.

other.title: Other
other.body: An occasion that does not fit the previous options.

casino-party.title: Casino Party complete experience
casino-party.body: A request for a coordinated proposal, not a package with a price or a number of tables.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.body: In-room entertainment, with no play for money.

blackjack.title: Blackjack
blackjack.body: A table guests can join. Lessons are not promised.

poker.title: Poker
poker.body: A social table, not a cash tournament.

dice.title: Dice
dice.body: To be considered in the proposal, not an automatic extra.

wheel-of-fortune.title: Wheel of Fortune
wheel-of-fortune.body: To be considered in the proposal, not an automatic extra.

selfie-mirror.title: Selfie Mirror
selfie-mirror.body: To be considered in the proposal, not an automatic extra.

experience-360.title: 360 Experience
experience-360.body: To be considered in the proposal, not an automatic extra.

other-games.title: Other games
other-games.body: Mention them in the message if you already have an idea.

recommendation.title: Recommend an experience
recommendation.body: We start from the event and suggest a possible experience.

errors.summary: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.

errors.datePast: Choose today or a later date.
errors.choice: One of the choices is not valid.
errors.notesMax: The message is longer than allowed.
errors.phone: Enter a valid telephone number, Swiss or international.
errors.companyMax: The company name is too long.
errors.preference: Choose how you would prefer to be contacted.
